title: 21 switchbacks cut into solid rock in 1926 #Shorts
description:
Walter's Wiggles: 21 steep switchbacks cut into solid rock in 1926, named for Walter Ruesch, Zion's first superintendent. The last hurdle before Scout Lookout.

Video: the channel's own footage from Zion (2021). Photos: NPS, HABS/HAER, NARA (Beaman/Hillers) and Wikimedia Commons (public domain, CC0).

▶ Full Zion documentary: https://youtu.be/ugASzW14E9s
